statement: Inspected Godot controller documentation states Godot 4.5+ on Linux routes gamepad input through SDL3; Unity Input System HID introduction describes Linux gamepad and joystick HIDs delivered through SDL. These engine paths inherit respective bundled/selected SDL build behavior. Which specific engine build exposes 28de:1302 native Triton features: No evidence; this does not assert live Godot/Unity acceptance. Godot docs lines 7-15; Unity HID introduction lines 1-20.
